args.message:
Implement banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) per FIN-212

The round_money helper claimed to use banker's rounding but actually
quantized with ROUND_HALF_UP, causing test_money.py::test_half_even to
fail in the nightly build. Use ROUND_HALF_EVEN to match FIN-212.

args.head: fin-212-round-half-even
args.title: Fix banker's rounding in round_money (FIN-212)
args.body:
## Summary
The nightly build failed because `tests/test_money.py::test_half_even` expects banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN, per FIN-212), but `src/money.py` quantized with ROUND_HALF_UP despite its docstring claiming banker's rounding.

## Change
- `src/money.py`: quantize with `ROUND_HALF_EVEN` instead of `ROUND_HALF_UP`.

## Verification
CI run `ci-0001` on this branch passed (includes the failing `test_half_even` test).

trace.final:
Done. Summary:

- **Root cause:** `src/money.py` imported `ROUND_HALF_UP` and used it in `round_money()`, even though the docstring claimed banker's rounding — so `tests/test_money.py::test_half_even` failed (e.g., 2.665 rounded to 2.67 instead of 2.66).
- **Fix:** Created branch `fin-212-round-half-even` and changed the quantize call to use `ROUND_HALF_EVEN` per FIN-212.
- **CI:** First run (`ci-0001`) passed, but main had advanced, so I merged latest main into the branch and re-ran CI (`ci-0002`) — also passed.
- **PR:** Opened PR #101 against main with alex as the requested reviewer: https://git.example/payments-service/pull/101

Merging will require code-owner approval per policy, so the PR is now awaiting alex's review.
